items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Yeah, that man hired me on a plenty little thing.

ctx.x: What about Toker? Did you ever work with Toker? Lawrence Toker? Oh yeah.

I'm glad you mention that. I'm sure glad you mention that. I forgot about him Toker. Yeah, that man hired me on a plenty little thing. Toker the trumpet player on a little Toker, sure. Yeah, I did a plenty thing with Toker. I know there was somebody I was there. I don't know it was somebody I was trying to think about. That's right.
What about, let's see, we got to Club Desire, did they have any acts there? Club Desire?
